findings.span: حتى إن كانت الإجابة لا الآن
findings.adjudication: The malformed construction remains present in live canonical main on 2026-08-20. The passage itself uses the natural phrase «ليس الآن», so q7 is inconsistent with its own source text and risks teaching malformed MSA.
findings.proposed_correction: Rewrite q7 around the natural learner-facing construction already present in the passage, e.g. test the concessive meaning of «حتى إن» using a grammatical clause such as «حتى إن كانت الإجابة: لا، ليس الآن», then revalidate answer a7 and grammar-target linkage.

findings.span: ما وظيفة «إذا» في «إذا كانت الأولوية واضحة، يصبح قول ليس الآن أسهل»؟
findings.adjudication: This is grammatically well-formed enough to be a separate issue from q7, but it explicitly asks for the function of a grammatical connector. B1 may tolerate some grammar-in-context work; repository standards prefer embedded communicative grammar review. Adjudicate pedagogical value rather than auto-repairing it.
